articles.title: Russia expected to intensify hybrid war on Europe - dw.com
articles.description: Drone explosions, airspace violations, arson attacks: Poland, Romania, and Moldova are now regularly targeted in Russian attacks against Ukraine. More governments are calling these attacks deliberate acts of aggression.
